host_processor_caches: Per node: 256 MiB L2, 672 MiB L3
host_storage_type: M.2 SATA SSD and E1.S NVMe SSD
host_storage_capacity: 2x 960 GB SATA boot SSD (RAID virtual disk), 2x 3.84 TB NVMe SSD
host_networking: 8x NVIDIA ConnectX-8 GPU-associated adapters; 2x NVIDIA ConnectX-7 dual-200G adapters; Intel X710-T2L management adapter
host_networking_topology: Quad-plane RoCE: four 200 Gb/s interfaces per GPU, 32 RDMA interfaces per node; GPU-affine rails
host_memory_configuration: 32x 96 GB DDR5 RDIMM, configured at 5200 MT/s; 2 NUMA nodes
accelerator_host_interconnect: PCIe Gen6 x16 GPU endpoint; PCIe Gen5 x16 upstream host path
accelerator_on-chip_memories: L2 cache and SM shared memory
hw_notes: Cisco UCS C880A M8; 64 GPUs total. Intra-node NVLink/NVSwitch; inter-node quad-plane RoCE. Socket bootstrap uses mgmt_eth or inet_eth according to the workload configuration.
framework: PyTorch NVIDIA Release 26.04 (Llama and GPT-OSS); 26.09 (DeepSeek and DLRMv4); 26.08 (Qwen), NVIDIA NeMo / Megatron, TensorRT-LLM (Qwen generation), TorchRec (DLRMv4)
other_software_stack: Llama and GPT-OSS: CUDA 13.2.1.009, NCCL 2.30.4-1; DeepSeek: CUDA 13.4.1.012, NCCL 2.31.2; Qwen: CUDA 13.4.1.012, NCCL 2.30.7+cuda13.3, TensorRT 11.2.1.2+cuda13.3; host NVIDIA kernel driver 595.71.05.
